cards.title: The approaches everything follows
cards.text: Each one a paragraph, with the decision record that holds its reasons.

cards.title: Our own loop, any provider
cards.text: The tool loop is ours, and each provider is a library a program hands in.

cards.title: One core, thin hosts
cards.text: Behaviour lives in core; a host only maps its protocol.

cards.title: Framework apart from agents
cards.text: Core ships no agent; identities and packs are what an agent is.

cards.title: Prompts are content
cards.text: Markdown embedded by level, and texts as enum templates.

cards.title: Measure everything
cards.text: Every request priced on the ledger, every answer shows its cost.

cards.title: Safe by construction
cards.text: Model text is data, tools stay in the workspace, a key guards the door.
